This gate uses the separately proved actual h-extension B, which adds central i and changes minimal/faithful local requirements; it does not refute the original A_Q statement. next_test: At p=3 construct the proposed action of z=(h-h_R)h_I^-1 on the actual local carrier and verify z^2=-I and commutation with every source matrix. The existing rank4 standard module fails exactly; an explicit rank8 extension is available. Then at p=5 retain both central components and verify the inherited adjoint swaps their idempotents: a single branch is not a quotient preserving the original star. On the full chosen process contract compute the q3, norm17 delta16, norm17 delta12 and norm17 delta20 transverse witnesses, and define a nontrivial genuine relative trace with its passive-sector and boundary treatment before any positivity experiment. A deliberately different nonfaithful or non-star object must not be promoted as that full contract.
object: For the actual pinned one-particle source h, B=A_Q[h]=M4(Q(i)), with A_Q=M2((-1,-1)_Q), and z=(h-h_R)h_I^-1=iI. At odd p the A_p minimal standard module has dimension4 over Q_p and scalar commutant. Extending it to B_p requires a central z_p with z_p^2=-I; this is impossible for p=3 mod4. At p=1 mod4, B_p=M4(Q_p)xM4(Q_p), each 4D branch annihilates a central idempotent; faithful local action requires both branches and dimension at least8. At 2 and infinity the quadratic center also gives dimension8. For source D(q)=diag(q,1), Q=Norm(q), delta=Norm(1-q), define mu_v=|Q|_v^(1/2)/|delta|_v. A chosen nonfaithful single split branch at p=1 mod4 and minimal modules elsewhere has formal transverse product sqrt(Q_split)/delta_split; the faithful rational B-module localizes with mu_v^2 everywhere and product1. Neither product is an operator trace. Seek one full source-process relative trace on a precisely chosen B carrier with central characters, adjoints, passive-sector treatment and all-place weights justified together.

scope: Conditional on preserving the entire actual source algebra including the given h by a unital rational-linear representation; h itself is not derived. Exact module statement over all local fields, with independent finite controls and explicit rational witnesses. Single split branch is NOT faithful for full localized B_p and is NOT a unital quotient preserving the original star: z*=-z swaps e_plus=(1+z/c)/2 and e_minus=(1-z/c)/2, so the branch kernel is not star-stable. This is algebraic, independent of p-adic positivity. No obstruction claimed for arbitrary nonlinear, infinite group-only or different process representations. Formal transverse products are not global traces or signed Weil forms. No new selected physical carrier, native gate synthesis, RH proof or factorization advantage.
stop_condition: Stop any full-source claim that retains rank4 at inert p, calls a single split branch faithful for B_p, treats holomorphic determinants as real additive Haar Jacobians, drops the passive sector without a relative trace definition, or promotes a formal product or finite check to signed Weil positivity. Stop quotient promotion without process/readout/adjoint compatibility and stop any identification of a constructed arithmetic representation with native physical selection.
